summary: Backend-only testing for WIBAZA marketplace. Executed 30 e2e pytest tests covering health, admin/seller/client auth flows (cookie JWT), admin stats, categories CRUD, seller pending approval + admin approve, product create/approve/list (public filters approved-only), cart, orders, Stripe checkout session creation (real test key -> returned checkout_url + session_id), Cloudinary image upload (real keys, returned secure_url on cloudinary.com), banners public+admin, announcements public+admin, admin ban/unban (banned login returns 403), admin soft delete user, commission generate + list + release-path, admin stock/products/payments overviews. 30/30 passed.

minor.issue: Review request mentioned POST /api/cart but actual endpoint is POST /api/cart/items (also GET/PUT under /items). Not a bug, just a spec mismatch to be aware of.
Router uses trailing slash on POST '/' — works but inconsistent with other routers that use empty path ''. Minor.
Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test with 422 (this is pydantic/email-validator behavior). Not a backend bug but consumers should be aware.

critical_code_review_comments: admin.py get_stats: uses `await db.list_collection_names()` inside every request just to check if 'commissions' collection exists — unnecessary; count_documents on a non-existent collection returns 0 safely in Mongo. Minor perf.
auth.py: cookies use secure=False. For production behind HTTPS ingress this should be True (and samesite='none' if cross-site). Currently OK for preview but should be env-driven.
products.py create_product: doesn't validate category_id exists in DB; a bad category_id will still create the product.

orders.py create_order: trusts client-supplied unit_price/total_price/seller_id in OrderItem — a malicious client can send lower prices. Server should re-price from DB (fetch product, compute total). This is a real security concern.

payments.py create_checkout: origin_url built from request.base_url will resolve to the backend host, not the frontend URL, so success_url/cancel_url will hit backend paths that don't exist. Should use FRONTEND_URL env var. Stripe still creates the session (test passed) but the redirect URLs will be wrong in production.
cart.py clear_cart route is defined as DELETE '/' (with trailing slash) — inconsistent with other cart routes that omit trailing slash.
auth.py cookie 'max_age=900' (15 min) for access_token but refresh endpoint exists — OK but frontend must handle 401->refresh transparently.
admin.py ban_user sets is_active=False, but seller pending approval and banned users both surface as 403 with different messages — good.
categories.py POST route defined as '/' rather than '' will trigger 307 redirect when client hits /api/categories without slash. Test handled both.
test_credentials: admin@wibaza.com / Admin@Wibaza2026 (verified working). Test users created dynamically with test_seller_{ts}@example.com / test_client_{ts}@example.com, password TestPass@2026.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates a fresh category (TEST_Cat_{ts}), banner, announcement, seller, client, product, order, cart item, stripe checkout session, cloudinary image. Client user is banned then soft-deleted at end. Other test data persists (Mongo, Cloudinary).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 30 backend endpoints listed in the review request are working. Regression test file at /app/backend/tests/test_wibaza_e2e.py. Emails ending in .test / .example are rejected by pydantic EmailStr — use example.com. Note the semi-bugs listed in critical_code_review_comments — especially payments checkout using request.base_url (backend host) for success/cancel URLs, and orders trusting client-supplied prices. Google OAuth endpoint /api/auth/google returns 503 by design because GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is empty (verified by review). Frontend testing was not requested in this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Initial test authoring hit a pydantic EmailStr issue (reserved .test TLD) which was fixed by using @example.com.
